info.title: Acume Consumer API

500.description: Unexpected server error (code: internal_error), or the invoice was created but the response could not be returned (code: created_response_unavailable). For the latter, retry with the same Idempotency-Key to receive the 201, or GET the invoice named in the message.

503.description: Temporarily unavailable -- see Retry-After header (code: service_unavailable).

400.description: Malformed JSON body (code: malformed_json), or the body failed validation (code: validation_error, with one `details` entry per field). Rarely, a body is rejected without a per-field breakdown (code: invalid_request, reason in `message`). An Idempotency-Key outside 1-150 characters is also code: invalid_request, with field: idempotency-key. Fix the request; the same Idempotency-Key may be reused.

403.description: The account is inactive and cannot create inbound invoices. Retrying will not help (code: forbidden).

409.description: A request with this Idempotency-Key has not finished yet, including after a 504 (code: idempotency_in_progress). Wait retry_after seconds, then retry with the same key and body. If it keeps returning 409, check GET /v1/inbound-invoices?ref_inv_number=<ref>&status=all before sending the invoice under a new key.

422.description: Idempotency-Key was already used with a different request payload (code: idempotency_key_reused).

502.description: The invoice could not be processed. This is not caused by the request body (code: upstream_error). Wait retry_after seconds and retry with the same Idempotency-Key and body; if an earlier attempt did create the invoice, the retry returns it instead of creating another.

504.description: The outcome could not be confirmed, so the invoice may or may not have been created (code: upstream_outcome_unknown). Retry with the same Idempotency-Key and body; do not switch to a new key. The retry returns 409 idempotency_in_progress until the outcome is known, then the invoice as a replayed 201 if it was created. If it keeps returning 409, check GET /v1/inbound-invoices?ref_inv_number=<ref>&status=all before sending it under a new key. Without a key, check with that GET before resending.

post.description:
Creates a supplier invoice. It is created with status 'received' and then goes through your coding, purchase-order matching and approval rules, so the status in the response may already have moved on.

**Provisional.** The request fields may still change.

The supplier is identified from `bank_account_number`, `tax_reg_no` and `legal_registration_identifier`. All three are optional; when none matches a supplier, the invoice is still created, with `supplier_number: null`.

`document_type` is 'Invoice' or 'Credit Note'. Whether the invoice is matched against purchase orders depends on your configuration, and the created invoice's `document_type` shows the result ('Invoice PO', 'Credit Note PO').

Line tax is calculated from the supplier's tax rate, so line-level tax fields are not accepted. Line amounts are not reconciled against the header totals. A possible duplicate is created and flagged with `is_duplicate`, not rejected.

Send an `Idempotency-Key`. If the response is lost, or is a 409, 429 or 5xx, retry with the **same** key and body: one key never creates more than one invoice, and after a `504` or `500 created_response_unavailable` the retry is how you receive the invoice. Only if a retry keeps returning `409 idempotency_in_progress`, check `GET /v1/inbound-invoices?ref_inv_number=<ref>&status=all` before sending it under a new key. Without a key, check with that GET before resending anything.

post.summary: Exchange an api_key for a JWT

400.description: api_key missing from the request body (code: invalid_request).

401.description: api_key does not match any client (code: invalid_api_key). NOTE: unlike every other endpoint's 401, this one IS the app's own Error envelope, since it's raised in application code (token_handler), not by an API Gateway authorizer -- this endpoint has no authorizer in front of it.

Error.description: Canonical error envelope. Every non-2xx response is {"error": ...} with this shape.

type.description: Broad Stripe-style category clients can branch on for coarse handling.

code.description: Stable machine-readable code for fine-grained branching.

field.description: Present on single-field errors outside `details` (e.g. a 404/409/400 caused by exactly one bad input, like a duplicate `code` or an unknown `gl_code`). Points at the offending field without parsing `message`.

details.description: Present only when code="validation_error": one entry per field violation.

field.description: Dotted path to the offending field, e.g. 'items.0.sku'.

message.description: Human-readable, always starts with a capital letter.

retry_after.description: Seconds to wait before retrying. Present on 409 idempotency_in_progress, 429, 502 and 503; also echoed in the Retry-After header.

request_id.description: Echoed in the x-request-id header. Include this when contacting support.

doc_url.description: Link to the docs page for this specific `code`. Not currently returned.

GatewayUnauthorizedError.description: API Gateway's default Unauthorized response for a denied/erroring TOKEN Lambda authorizer (auth/lambda_function.py::authorizer_handler). Distinct from the app's Error schema -- the request never reaches the application.

account_number.description: Bank account number. Letters and digits only. Spaces and hyphens are accepted but stripped before storage (e.g. '12-3456 7890' becomes '1234567890'). The stripped value must be at most 34 characters -- the ISO 13616 maximum IBAN length, which accommodates every national account number format.

is_default.description: Whether this is the default account for payments. At most one account in a given bank_accounts list may be explicitly true; submitting more than one raises a validation error.
is_default.title: Is Default

TaxCategory.description: Closed vocabulary of supplier tax categories.
TaxCategory.title: TaxCategory

supplier_number.description: Unique supplier identifier, set at creation and immutable thereafter (not present on UpdateSupplierInput). Accepts letters (any language), numbers, spaces, and - . , ' " & ( ). '/' is rejected because this value is used as a URL path segment. Other characters, including HTML tags and control characters, are rejected.
supplier_number.title: Supplier Number

name.description: Supplier name. Accepts letters (any language), numbers, spaces, and - . , ' " & ( ) /. Other characters, including HTML tags and control characters, are rejected.
name.title: Name

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code (e.g. NZ, AU). Case-insensitive; normalized to uppercase. Only NZ and AU are saved, other country codes are discarded.
country.title: Country

currency.description: ISO 4217 3-letter alphabetic currency code (e.g. NZD, AUD, USD).
currency.title: Currency

full_formal_name.description: Full legal/formal name of the supplier, if different from `name`. Accepts letters (any language), numbers, spaces, and - . , ' " & ( ) /. Other characters, including HTML tags and control characters, are rejected.
full_formal_name.title: Full Formal Name

tax_rate.description:
Case-insensitive; '%' suffix optional for numeric values (e.g. '10' matches '10%').

Allowed values by tax_category:

| tax_category | Allowed tax_rate |
|---|---|
| S (Standard) | `15%`, `12%`, `10%` |
| E (Exempt) | `No Tax` |
| Z (Zero-rated) | `0%` |
| C | `10%` |
| G | `No Tax` |
| O | `No Tax` |
tax_rate.title: Tax Rate

InboundInvoiceItemInput.description:
One invoice line.

Only `net_amount` is required. Everything else is optional because the platform's
intake adapter treats it as optional and OCR-sourced invoices routinely arrive with
sparse lines.

Line-level `vat_rate`, `tax_amount`, `invoiced_item_vat_category_code` and
`tax_scheme` are not accepted here: the platform stamps them from the resolved
supplier and recalculates line tax from the net amount and that rate, so a caller's

CreateInboundInvoiceInput.description:
A supplier invoice submitted for intake into the platform.

This API validates and forwards the request to the einvoicing platform's shared
intake service. The field names, casing and rules below mirror
`App\Http\Requests\ConsumerApiInboundInvoiceRequest` and
`App\Services\Intake\Adapters\ConsumerApiIntakeAdapter`; see
docs/design/phase-2/inbound-invoice-create-contract.md for what is still open.

Supplier identification is by evidence, not by identifier. The platform resolves the
supplier through OCR's own matchers so that ownership and active-status checks happen
once for every origin, and those matchers take the bank account number, tax
registration number and legal registration identifier printed on the invoice. All three are optional and none has to resolve: a
handwritten docket carries none of them, and the platform creates the invoice
unresolved rather than refusing it. `seller_id` and `supplier_number` are still
rejected: the platform marks `seller_id` `missing`, so accepting either here would
produce a downstream 422 or be ignored.

Two things this schema deliberately does not do:

Header/line reconciliation. An earlier draft summed the line amounts and rejected the
request when they missed the header totals by more than 0.01. That rule cannot be
honoured: the platform recalculates each line's tax from its net amount and the VAT
rate rather than storing what was sent, so an invoice that passed the check would
still be stored with different line tax than the caller supplied. Rejecting requests
against a rule the persistence layer then overrides is worse than not checking.

Supplier existence, duplicate identity and coding validity. All resolved downstream,
once, for every origin. `branch` and `department` follow the same rule: this schema
checks their shape only, and the platform resolves them through OCR's segment
cascade, which falls back to supplier and client defaults rather than failing when an
identifier does not resolve.

Tenancy is not a field. The client is taken from the authenticated caller, never from
the body, and travels to the platform in a header.

Not guaranteed unique: duplicate detection is configurable per client and runs in the platform, which may flag the created invoice rather than reject it. Accepts letters (any language), numbers, spaces, and - . , ' " & ( ) /. Other characters, including HTML tags and control characters, are rejected.

Accepts letters (any language), numbers, spaces, and - . , ' " & ( ) /. Other characters, including HTML tags and control characters, are rejected.

tax_reg_no.description: Supplier tax registration number (e.g. GST number) as printed on the invoice, used to resolve the supplier. The same field as on the supplier resource. Optional. Accepts letters (any language), numbers, spaces, and - . , ' " & ( ) /. Other characters, including HTML tags and control characters, are rejected.

The same field as on the supplier resource. Optional. Accepts letters (any language), numbers, spaces, and - . , ' " & ( ) /. Other characters, including HTML tags and control characters, are rejected.
